---
title: "Scatter Contour Plots (Lite)"
subtitle: "All 15 dimension pairs ranked by Path2D DPS for thresholds 7 & 8"
---

## Overview

Display combined faceted scatter contour plots for all 15 dimension pairs per threshold, ranked by Path2D DPS (highest first).

## Setup

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

pacman::p_load(patchwork, ggdensity, install = FALSE)

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: load-custom-functions

source(here("custom_func/make_faceted_scatter_and_contour_plot.R"))
source(here("custom_func/plot_density_evolution.R"))
```

## Constants

```{r}
#| label: constants

THRESHOLDS <- c(7, 8)

trajectory_colors <- c(
  stable_normal = "#1f77b4",
  normal2mci = "#ff7f0e",
  stable_mci = "#2ca02c",
  normal2incid = "#d62728",
  mci2incid = "#9467bd",
  prev_dementia = "#8c564b"
)
```

## Load Data

```{r}
#| label: load-data

# Load per-threshold data
load_threshold_data <- function(t) {
  list(
    dps_results = read_rds(here(glue("UMAP/lite/output/dps_results_threshold_{t}.rds"))),
    normal_repeated = read_rds(here(glue("UMAP/lite/output/normal_repeated_threshold_{t}.rds"))),
    plot_limits = read_rds(here(glue("UMAP/lite/output/plot_limits_threshold_{t}.rds"))),
    centroids = read_rds(here(glue("UMAP/lite/output/centroids_threshold_{t}.rds")))
  )
}

threshold_data <- THRESHOLDS |>
  set_names() |>
  map(load_threshold_data)

walk(THRESHOLDS, \(t) message(glue("Threshold {t}: {nrow(threshold_data[[as.character(t)]]$dps_results)} dim pairs")))
```

## Generate Plots

```{r}
#| label: generate-plots
#| output: false

generate_threshold_plots <- function(t) {
  td <- threshold_data[[as.character(t)]]
  pairs <- td$dps_results |> arrange(dps_rank)

  pairs |>
    pmap(\(threshold, dimx, dimy, path2d_dps, dps_rank, ...) {
      rank_label <- glue("{dps_rank} of 15")

      centroid_data <- td$centroids |>
        filter(dimx == !!dimx, dimy == !!dimy) |>
        mutate(rank_dps_label = glue("Rank: {rank_label} | DPS: {round(path2d_dps, 3)}"))

      plot_faceted <- make_faceted_scatter_and_contour_plot(
        .data = td$normal_repeated,
        x_var = dimx,
        y_var = dimy,
        threshold = glue("threshold_{t}"),
        adjust = c(1.0, 1.0)
      ) +
        # lims(
        #   x = c(td$plot_limits[[dimx]][1], td$plot_limits[[dimx]][2]),
        #   y = c(td$plot_limits[[dimy]][1], td$plot_limits[[dimy]][2])
        # ) +
        labs(x = str_to_upper(dimx), y = str_to_upper(dimy))

      plot_evolution <- plot_density_evolution(
        .data = centroid_data,
        dim_cols = c(dimx, dimy),
        statistic = "mean",
        trajectory_colors = trajectory_colors
      ) +
        facet_wrap(vars(rank_dps_label)) +
        labs(x = str_to_upper(dimx), y = str_to_upper(dimy)) +
        theme(strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

      combined <- plot_faceted + plot_evolution +
        plot_layout(widths = c(4, 1)) +
        plot_annotation(
          title = glue("Threshold {t}: {dimx} vs {dimy}"),
          theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"))
        )

      list(scatter = plot_faceted, peak = plot_evolution, combined = combined)
    })
}

all_plots <- THRESHOLDS |>
  set_names() |>
  map(generate_threshold_plots)
```

# Threshold 8

All 15 dimension pairs for threshold 8, ranked by Path2D DPS.

```{r}
#| label: fig-threshold-8
#| fig-width: 18
#| fig-height: 6

walk(all_plots[["8"]], \(plt) print(plt$combined))
```

# Threshold 7

All 15 dimension pairs for threshold 7, ranked by Path2D DPS.

```{r}
#| label: fig-threshold-7
#| fig-width: 18
#| fig-height: 6

walk(all_plots[["7"]], \(plt) print(plt$combined))
```

## Save Plots

```{r}
#| label: save-plots

walk(THRESHOLDS, \(t) {
  td <- threshold_data[[as.character(t)]]
  pairs <- td$dps_results |> arrange(dps_rank)
  plots <- all_plots[[as.character(t)]]

  subdir <- here(glue("UMAP/lite/scatter/output/fig_tbl/threshold{t}"))
  fs::dir_create(subdir)

  iwalk(plots, \(plt, i) {
    rank_str <- sprintf("%02d", pairs$dps_rank[i])

    ggsave(
      here(subdir, glue("scatter_rank{rank_str}.png")),
      plt$scatter, width = 18, height = 6, dpi = 300,
      bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png
    )
    write_rds(plt$scatter, here(subdir, glue("scatter_rank{rank_str}.rds")))

    ggsave(
      here(subdir, glue("peak_rank{rank_str}.png")),
      plt$peak, width = 6, height = 6, dpi = 300,
      bg = "white", device = ragg::agg_png
    )
    write_rds(plt$peak, here(subdir, glue("peak_rank{rank_str}.rds")))
  })
})

message("Saved scatter and peak plots to fig_tbl/scatter/")
```
